notes: §1985:XIV.2.2.4 GR17: a destination count "outside the range of 1 through integer-1" means "an error condition is indicated, no action is taken for any destination"; otherwise the MCS uses occurrences 1 through the count. MessageControlSession.ValidCount is checked first by Send, Purge and SetOutput (ENABLE/DISABLE OUTPUT) and returns status 30 before any destination is touched; the loops run i = 1..count over CommunicationArea.Destination(i). Probes at 85: count 0, integer-1 + 1, 9999, 18-digit truncated to 9999, non-numeric and spaces all gave 30 on SEND, PURGE, ENABLE and DISABLE OUTPUT with error keys and queues untouched; count = integer-1 delivered to each; the witness checks 0, 3, 2 without a table, 1 and 2.

next.reason: 1985: "the content of the data item referenced by data-name-1 will indicate to the MCS the number of symbolic destinations"; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the communication description entry; none of the candidates covers CD destination counts.". The communication module (CD entry, SEND/PURGE/ENABLE OUTPUT) has no 2023 counterpart. The candidates are about OCCURS, data, sort and screen entries, not MCS destinations.
